download_signup_retry_title: Create your account to keep downloading
download_signup_retry_body: Registration is quick: use Google or GitHub, or enter your email and password. Most people finish in under a minute.
download_signup_retry_benefits: After registration, you can continue downloads, keep batch progress, remember downloaded collection items, and manage points from your account.
download_signup_cn_title: Use email if Google or GitHub is slow
download_signup_cn_body: Google and GitHub sign-up may require access to those sites. If the page does not move after clicking them, email registration is usually faster and more reliable.
download_signup_cn_retry_body: If Google or GitHub did not open, your network may not be able to reach them. Email registration is simple and usually finishes in under a minute.
download_signup_cn_subtext: Email registration does not depend on Google or GitHub and usually finishes in under a minute.
bmc_terms: One-time purchase. No subscription or auto-renewal. Credits never expire.
bmc_usage_example: Example: a video up to 1 minute is estimated at 2 credits under standard video download pricing. Other features may use different rates.
bmc_checkout_notice: Pay through Buy Me a Coffee for FreeSaveVideo. After payment, submit your code on the thank-you page to receive credits.
bmc_copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the entire code manually.

bmc_save_required: Copy your code to unlock payment
bmc_submit_hint: On the Buy Me a Coffee thank-you page, find the payment-code question, paste the full code starting with cpt_, and submit your answer. Payment alone does not add credits.
bmc_return_hint: Return here and check status after submitting your code.
bmc_help: Paid but no credits? Get help
bmc_help_hint: Attach your receipt to the email. Your order code is included automatically. Do not pay again or include card details.
